name: Hiring Signals Intelligence
description: CLI-first tool, built for AI agents to query on a person's behalf, that surfaces genuine, scored, filterable IT hiring signals from 8 ATS providers via official documented APIs (no scraping). Signals detect: new roles, reopened roles, hiring bursts, role acceleration, multi-location expansion, persistent demand.
author: Teycir Ben Soltane
framework: none (CLI-first, apps/web deleted 2026-08-07, replaced by apps/cli)
search: Workers AI (@cf/baai/bge-base-en-v1.5) + Vectorize 768-dim cosine index — write path (embed-at-ingest, gated on new-or-content-changed, non-blocking) AND query-side hybrid search (keyword + semantic merge on page 1) both live on GET /api/v1/signals (Milestone I.3 complete). Falls back to keyword-only gracefully on subsequent pages or if semantic path degrades.

deployment.ui: none — apps/web deleted 2026-08-07, primary interface is apps/cli thin client over HTTP API

architecture.apps/cli: CLI, primary interface -> complete, landed 2026-08-07 (ROADMAP.md Milestone F.1). JSON-by-default stdout, single-JSON-object stderr errors, never interactive prompts (admin commands require explicit --yes). --format table flat-list renderer added 2026-08-10 (G.5 section 16.2), nested shapes decline and fall back to JSON with a stderr note. Saved filter profiles (--save / --clear-saved / auto-apply) at ~/.hiring-signals/config.json. Commands: hs signals list/get, companies list/get/timeline, facets, sources list, export signals, feed-url, trends hiring, admin source run/scheduler flush/reconcile. 59 tests across 5 suites.
architecture.apps/api: Cloudflare Worker API: routes, 15-min cron scheduler (deterministic per-source jitter) -> INGEST_QUEUE consumer (multi-chunk continuation for 700+ job boards, JOBS_PER_CHUNK=40 to stay under 1000-subrequest free-plan cap, in-flight stacking guard via hasRecentRunningRun(45min window)), daily reconciliation cron at 06:00 UTC (stale score recompute + company hiring velocity recompute for touched companies), semantic-search service, RSS 2.0 feed route, company hiring timeline route, cross-company hiring trends route, CSV export route, 3 bearer-secret-gated POST /admin/* pipeline triggers. Middleware chain: request-id, trusted-first CF-Connecting-IP extraction (spoofing protection), security headers, circuit-breaker-wrapped D1 client ("db" resource), anti-abuse rate-limiting (SHA-256 base64url-hashed identifiers), free-read-tier enforcement, per-request Analytics Engine API_METRICS data points for error-rate/latency monitoring (UUID/slug path segments normalized to :id/:param for bounded cardinality).
architecture.packages/domain: Zod schemas, 10 IT role categories taxonomy, job classification (description-channel noise guard), lifecycle (3-day absence threshold before reopened_role flag), signal scoring v2 (0.35*freshness + 0.25*volume + 0.20*acceleration + 0.10*breadth + 0.10*classification_confidence), company hiring velocity scoring (0-100 investor-grade, V = 0.40*acceleration + 0.25*breadth + 0.20*volume_norm + 0.15*persistence, null = not-yet-computed, never fabricated as 0), embedding-text builder, hybrid keyword-semantic search-merge logic, shared signal-id-param / company-slug-param schemas for route path-param validation, shared HIRING_VELOCITY_DISCLAIMER constant (spec section 11.3).
architecture.packages/adapters: AtsAdapter interface; 8 active ATS adapters (coverage closed at 8, decided with user 2026-08-04): Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee, Personio, Breezy. Breezy and Personio custom-host validation fixed 2026-08-10: port-injection bug (isValidCustomHost() used url.host instead of url.hostname + url.port check). 5 targeted unit tests per adapter including the port-injection case.
architecture.packages/db: D1 parameterized client wrapper (all SQL via .bind(), never string interpolation; all calls routed through circuit-breaker bulkhead on the "db" resource); repository functions covering all read/write paths — signals list/detail/for-export/for-feed, companies list/detail/timeline/velocity-update, facets aggregate counts, cross-company hiring trends, company-role activity stats (per-role and all-role aggregates), jobs upsert with batch() combine + lifecycle statements, sources with due-scheduler selection + in-flight run detection + progress checkpoint + run observation/complete recording, signal write path with active-signal dedup (28-day lookback, UNIQUE one-active-per-triple index), signals export, raw payload archival interface. All repos used via zero-mocks live-D1 test harness.
architecture.packages/test-support: Live Cloudflare transport bindings for zero-mocks integration testing per AGENTS.md policy. Real D1 via wrangler d1 execute --remote --json subprocess (3 total retries only for transient auth failures), real Workers AI/Vectorize via direct Cloudflare REST API (the same shape backfill-embeddings.mjs establishes), real KV via wrangler kv CLI. Thin wrappers preserve D1Client / D1Database / Ai / VectorizeIndex / KVNamespace type surfaces so app code runs completely unmodified in tests. Environment seams: D1_DATABASE_NAME/D1_WRANGLER_ENV for CI-database targeting. No in-memory stand-ins ever.
architecture.lib: Cross-workspace generic utilities, nothing here imports @hiring-signals/* domain symbols: d1/client (parameterized wrapper, circuit-breaker integrated), d1/like-pattern (LIKE wildcard escape), d1/unique-constraint (cross-driver UNIQUE-violation detection: wrangler CLI error_code + Worker D1Error.code surfaces), kv/ttl-store (generic prefix-based TTL blob store), http/circuit-breaker (per-resource bulkhead + concurrency cap), http/rate-limit (KV sliding window, free/protected presets, safeRateLimitIdentifier SHA-256 base64url hashes before key construction to scrub IP PII and block IPv6 colon separator injection), http/security-headers (Hono middleware, explicit CORS allowlist), observability/audit-abuse (fire-and-forget KV abuse logging), pagination/cursor (opaque keyset codec with sort-mode tagging so sort changes between pages throw instead of corrupting), text/base64url (UTF-8-safe + JSON helpers), text/content-hash (SHA-256 stable-key-order object hash for observation diff detection), text/csv (RFC-4180 row serializer with proper quoting/escaping), text/location-mode (remote/hybrid/onsite inference from free text), text/rss (dependency-free RSS 2.0 serializer with XML escaping, RFC 822 dates, <link> omission when null).
architecture.infrastructure: D1 migrations 0001-0009 (initial_schema, signal_evidence_indexes, rename_raw_payload_key, job_observations_idempotency UNIQUE, signals_dedup_index, signals_one_active_unique, trends_role_first_seen_index, company_velocity_score NULL columns, jobs_requisition_id NULL column). Ops scripts: add-source.mjs, update-source.mjs (--run-now clears next_poll_at for manual ingestion trigger), add-company.mjs, update-company.mjs (--industry --employee-band --remote tags, blank values are rejected not silently cleared), source-health.mjs (stale/stuck/degraded/disabled derivation with STALE_RUNNING_MINUTES=90 threshold), backfill-embeddings.mjs (Vectorize backfill for semantic search), build-category-centroids.mjs (Worker AI category centroids for role-auto-classify gap), import-sources.mjs (bulk CSV onboarding with pre-validation and duplicate skipping), ingestion-metrics.mjs (success rate + duplicate rate with/without requisitionId tiering, GROUP BY split on requisition_id IS NULL), seed-local-d1.sql (local D1 seed fixtures).

API error-rate monitoring (G.5 section 16.3.6 gap closed): [[analytics_engine_datasets]] binding API_METRICS (dataset hiring_signals_api_metrics) added to wrangler.toml, middleware apps/api/src/middleware/api-metrics.ts registered via app.use("*", ...) immediately after request-id. Writes one data point per completed request: blobs = [method, normalizeRoutePath(path)], doubles = [status, durationMs], indexes = [routeShape]. normalizeRoutePath collapses UUIDs into :id via UUID regex, company slugs and other non-static-route words into :param via a not-in-static-route-word-set fallback, cross-checked against every actual route file (sources has no :sourceId detail route; export is literal signals.csv; feed is literal feed.rss). writeDataPoint wrapped in its own try/catch so dropped metric never propagates to fail a request. 12 pure-function tests in api-metrics.test.ts for normalizeRoutePath.

Source-health.mjs stuck-run detection gap (G.3, 2026-08-11): derivedStatus() only branched on enabled/consecutive_failures/'failed_final' so 277 openai rows stuck permanently at 'running' showed as 'healthy, 0 failures'. Added running_minutes via correlated scalar subquery on the same latest-run lookup (julianday delta * 24*60), STALE_RUNNING_MINUTES=90, new 'stuck' status branch checked BEFORE degraded/failed so low consecutive_failures can't mask it. Verified live: post-2026-08-11 subrequest-batching fix no source currently stuck, correctly reports healthy; 90-minute bound is generous over shortest 360-min poll interval to catch 'never resolved' not 'slow but real'.

Ingest consumer per-job D1 subrequest over-cap fix (J.4, same-day root cause from ingestion-metrics 9.1%): processNormalizedJob was 3 D1 calls/job (upsert + observation + lifecycle) deterministically exceeding the 1000-service-subrequest cap at ~340+ jobs. Split upsertJob into prepareJobUpsert (prerequisite SELECT, returns {sql, params} not executed) + thin wrapper preserving signature; same for applyLifecycleTransition -> buildLifecycleStatement pure builder + thin wrapper. Now processNormalizedJob does SELECT -> compute lifecycle in JS -> single client.batch([upsertStmt, lifecycleStmt]) for the pair: cuts that pair from 2 D1 calls to 1. insertObservationIdempotent deliberately kept unbatched: its idempotency contract depends on catching its own UNIQUE violation in isolation, batching it would let a legitimate retry's no-op roll back the other writes (documented in file header). processMissingJobs left unbatched.

Ingest consumer retry logic: provider validation errors and schema mismatches (config/programmer errors) now skip retry and set correct source_run.status and error_code. Only network failures (429, 5xx) trigger exponential backoff retry, MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS=5. Retry increment bug fixed: replaced broken native message.retry() with explicit INGEST_QUEUE.send() carrying attempt + 1, so attempts actually increment. Retry-After header honored for 429s.

Scheduler stacked-run growth fix (2026-08-14, 577 concurrent running rows root cause): getDueSources selects any source where next_poll_at IS NULL OR next_poll_at <= now(). next_poll_at only advances via markSourceSuccess on fully-successful final-chunk completion, so boards that never completed (openai, whatever the per-chunk kill itself is — still unconfirmed) had next_poll_at NULL forever, so EVERY 15-min cron tick stacked a brand-new runId from chunkOffset 0, regardless of whether a prior run's own continuation chain was still active. Fix: new hasRecentRunningRun(client, sourceId, now, staleAfterMinutes=45) in packages/db/src/sources-repo.ts — true if a source_runs row exists still status='running' with started_at within 45 minutes. handleScheduled now calls it before enqueueing and skips any due source still in flight. 45 min is well over one 15-min cron interval so legitimate multi-chunk continuation is never misflagged. 5 new live-D1 tests in sources-repo.test.ts; 3 new in scheduler.test.ts (which also fixed cleanup order to delete source_runs before sources for FK safety; 6f82cd4a deployed 2026-08-14, verified live post-deploy: openai concurrent running count held flat across 2 full cron ticks, single active run's jobs_normalized advanced 320->480 with scheduler_skip_already_running logged correctly)

ENVIRONMENT var mislabel fix (apps/api wrangler.toml hygiene): top-level [vars] ENVIRONMENT was still 'development' from scaffolding despite top-level config being actual production deploy (no [env.production] block exists; only [env.ci]). Confirmed actually unused at runtime — only reference is Bindings type declaration, no route/middleware/job reads it — but corrected to 'production' for hygiene so any future code that branches on env finds the right label immediately.

JOBS_PER_CHUNK re-tune from 150 to 40 after full end-to-end processNormalizedJob cost accounting: J.4 only optimized the upsert+lifecycle pair from 3->2 calls, but observation insert + conditional embed + Vectorize upsert + classification update + activity stats read + active signal read + signal create + evidence append + generateCompanySignals triggers all add up to roughly 14 worst-case subrequests per new job (not ~2). 150*14 ~ 2100 was well over the 1000 free-plan cap. 40*14 ~ 560 leaves comfortable headroom. JOBS_PER_CHUNK_OVERRIDE env seam also added for tests to use tiny chunk sizes without touching the production constant.

Ingest consumer multi-chunk continuation (2026-08-13, 700+ Ashby boards never completing): processes at most JOBS_PER_CHUNK jobs per invocation starting at chunkOffset, then re-enqueues a continuation IngestMessage for the remainder instead of processing the full board. Continuation forwards sourceId + boardFetchMeta + runId from the original so dedupe/observations stay coherent across chunks. JOBS_PER_CHUNK_OVERRIDE test seam for small-chunk tests. Combined with JOBS_PER_CHUNK=40, this keeps any single invocation's subrequest budget inside the 1000-subrequest cap.

Temporary diagnostic checkpoint recordSourceRunProgress(sourceRunId, jobsNormalized): writes only the jobs_normalized counter column every 10 jobs inside the chunk loop — never touches status/completed_at so it never interferes with recordSourceRunComplete. Added because multiple openai runs died partway through a chunk with zero JS-catchable error and no error_code populated — a platform-level kill bypasses the entire function's try/catch leaving jobs_normalized permanently NULL. Explicitly documented as temporary in both function header and ROADMAP.md G.3's follow-up checkbox, to be removed once the actual per-chunk kill is root-caused via wrangler tail.

explicitlyNotPlanned: Authentication / user accounts / login flows on the read surface — app is public/free permanently by deliberate design decision (spec sections 3, 10.5, 11.1), not a gap awaiting Cloudflare Access or similar. Admin trigger endpoints already use bearer-secret gating which is the extent of auth ever planned.

Preview / staging tiers with separate deploy targets — G.4 environment-scope decision (2026-08-06, repo owner): stays simplified as Local (wrangler dev + local D1) + Production (hiring-signals) + isolated CI database (hiring-signals-ci) for live-D1 test runs only. No separate Preview/Staging registries planned. If this decision is ever revisited, the retained G.4 guardrail applies: preview/staging must NEVER point at production secrets or write bindings (spec section 15.1).

roleLevel: reopened roles (3-day absence threshold before flagging)
still active roles (daily reconciliation appends still_active evidence to prevent score decay)
companyLevel: role acceleration (pace vs 56-day baseline via computeAcceleration)
multi-location expansion (3+ distinct locations same role)

fields: requisition_id (when adapter exposes it, for duplicate detection tiering)

filtering: by role (10 IT categories, comma-delimited list singular --role flag)
by company (free-text company search, LIKE wildcards properly escaped)
keyword search on company name / signal headline / signal summary
hybrid keyword+semantic search via Workers AI embeddings + Vectorize cosine on page 1 of results
features.savedFilterProfiles: CLI-local only: hs signals list --save stores raw pre-parse filter flags (not schema-parsed defaults, so sort/limit/minScore are NEVER silently baked into saved profile) at ~/.hiring-signals/config.json or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/hiring-signals/config.json. No-flag invocation auto-applies with a one-line stderr note so stdout stays pure JSON. --clear-saved removes with JSON confirmation. Corrupt JSON silently discarded via safeParse.
features.companyHiringTimeline: GET /companies/:slug/timeline + hs companies timeline. Time-bucketed 7/14/30-day caller-selectable windows (90-day hard cap with explicit 400 on exceed). newJobsCount/closedJobsCount (approximate — exact close date not observable, documented as such)/activeJobsCount per bucket + roleBreakdown/locationBreakdown top-5 each + distinct signalTypes per bucket.
features.crossCompanyHiringTrends: GET /trends/hiring + hs trends hiring. Cross-company ranked analytics with acceleration_desc/volume_desc/newest_signal/velocity_desc sorts, industry free-text / country / role comma-list / recency-since filters, per-company top-5-location breakdown, KV-cached 5 minutes per actual-affecting-params cache key (resolveTrendsSince + buildTrendsCacheKey pure helpers unit-tested).
features.hiringVelocityPerCompany: Investor-grade 0-100 company score: V = clamp(0.40*acceleration + 0.25*breadth + 0.20*volume_norm + 0.15*persistence, 0, 1) * 100. Reuses computeAcceleration/computeBreadth from signal-score.ts but feeds company-wide counts. Persisted as 3 nullable companies columns (hiring_velocity_score, velocity_score_version, velocity_computed_at) — NULL = not-yet-computed, never fabricated as 0. Recomputed daily only for companies that had >=1 signal genuinely reconciled in that run (touchedCompanyIds Set tracking, not scanned wholesale). Surfaced on companies list/detail + trends hiring, velocity_desc sort option (nulls sort last). Shared HIRING_VELOCITY_DISCLAIMER: 'Based on pace, breadth, and persistence of public hiring activity. Not a prediction of intent or budget.' (spec section 11.3) carried in meta on all three endpoints.
features.rssFeed: GET /feed.rss + hs feed-url. RSS 2.0 at 50-item cap, ETag/Last-Modified/304 Not Modified conditional-request support, XML-escaped content, RFC 822 dates. <link> omitted entirely for aggregate signals with no job-linked evidence (canonical_url is null). Filterable by the same signal filters as the REST route; same-param names, byte-identical query shape via shared queryFromRecord serializer in CLI. No KV caching; conditional requests are the whole optimization.
features.export: CSV export of filtered signal list (GET /api/v1/export/signals.csv, spec section 10.6, live) — RFC-4180 via lib/text/csv.ts, 2000-row safety cap with X-Export-Truncated header. Also exposed as hs export signals [--filters] [--out path] in CLI (omitting --out streams raw CSV to stdout as the only command whose stdout isn't JSON; with --out writes file + prints write confirmation JSON).
features.ingestion: 15-min cron scheduler with deterministic per-source jitter across a 10-minute window on every tick -> INGEST_QUEUE with max_batch_size=10 sequential consumer. Multi-chunk continuation (40 jobs/invocation max, re-enqueue rest) to stay under 1000-service-subrequest cap. hasRecentRunningRun(45-min) stacking guard prevents scheduler-run piling for boards that never complete. Daily reconciliation at 06:00 UTC: per-signal stale score recompute (no last_detected_at touch) + per-touched-company hiring velocity recompute. Ingest idempotent per (sourceId, runId).
monitoringAndObservability: source-health.mjs: per-source derived status derivation — stale (next_poll_at over 2x poll_interval in past) / stuck (running_minutes > 90 via correlated subquery, catches the 277-row openai failure mode) / degraded (consecutive_failures >=1 and not stuck/stale) / failed_final (consecutive_failures >= 3 and latest run failed_final) / disabled

ingestion-metrics.mjs: 30-day success rate (succeeded / total runs) + duplicate detection rate with/without requisitionId tiering (two GROUP BY queries, split on requisition_id IS NULL because only 3/8 adapters expose requisitionId and a single global bucket would silently collapse all NULL rows to same company/title/location)

Analytics Engine API_METRICS middleware: one data point per completed request — normalizeRoutePath collapses UUID/slug segments to keep cardinality bounded, doubles=[status, durationMs], writeDataPoint try/catch swallowed so dropped metric never propagates

nonGoals: no collection of private profiles or personal data
no bypassing logins, CAPTCHAs, rate limits, robots directives
no general-purpose HTML scraping (official documented ATS APIs only)

no email digests, webhook alerting, or browser push notifications (RSS feed route via external feed reader handles 'notify me later' gap — feed is still pull-from-the-reader's-perspective, not a direct outbound push from this app storing destination addresses)
no automated sending of cold email or LinkedIn messages
no claims about confirmed projects, budgets, or purchasing decisions; company-level hiring claims always carry the shared HIRING_VELOCITY_DISCLAIMER

dev.cli: apps/cli has no server: run `pnpm --filter @hiring-signals/api dev` in one terminal, then `HS_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787 node apps/cli/bin/hs.mjs <command>` in another

testing.fastPureLogic: pnpm --filter @hiring-signals/domain test (~93 tests, ~1s, pure functions + Zod)
testing.fastAdapterFixtures: pnpm --filter @hiring-signals/adapters test (~114 tests, ~3s, static JSON/XML board-response fixtures, no network)
testing.liveCloudflare: Requires CF_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN env + real network (AGENTS.md zero-mocks policy). ALWAYS scope to the specific file you touched — full suite is 10+ minutes due to ~3.7s per D1 subprocess cold start. Pattern: cd packages/db && npx vitest run test/signals-export-repo.test.ts (or test/*-repo.test.ts / apps/api/test/**/*.test.ts). apps/api vitest has 90s per-test default timeout; reconciliation/ingest-consumer suites can genuinely exceed even in isolation (full pipeline is ~65s min for the happy-path end-to-end).
testing.ciCoverage: .github/workflows/ci.yml on every push/PR: typecheck + lint + domain/adapters pure-logic tests only (~45s total). Live-D1/db/api suites are manual-only, require live credential.

aiAgentDiscovery.primaryUseCase: Job discovery and hiring intelligence platform — CLI-first design explicitly optimized for AI agents querying on a person's behalf
aiAgentDiscovery.targetAudience: IT job seekers (active and passive), analysts/investors tracking hiring velocity, recruitment researchers — specifically AI agents acting on a person's instructions via CLI (JSON-by-default stdout, single-JSON-object stderr errors, exit codes by convention, never interactive prompts)
keyDifferentiators: Direct official ATS API integration, never HTML scraping
Real-time signal detection beyond raw listings: hiring bursts, role acceleration, multi-location expansion, persistent demand
Investor-grade company-level hiring velocity score with documented formula and null-for-uncomputed semantics
Evidence-based job verification: every signal carries canonical URL, source job ID, timestamps, not AI hallucinated listings
CLI-first, JSON-by-default, built for agent callers: exit codes, never interactive prompts, stdout/stderr strict separation, saved filter profiles for automation
Hybrid keyword + semantic search (Workers AI embeddings + Vectorize cosine) degrades gracefully to keyword-only
RSS feed route with conditional-request support: 'notify me later' is external feed-reader poll, no email/webhook push, no account/personal-data storage requirement
Pull-only delivery model: this app never stores a destination address to initiate outbound contact with a user
implementationPatterns: Monorepo with pnpm workspaces, 6 workspace packages, strict tsconfig with noUncheckedIndexedAccess on
Zod schema validation shared across API routes and CLI via packages/domain exports (signalsQuerySchema, trendsQuerySchema, companyTimelineQuerySchema) — single source of truth
Cloudflare edge computing: Cloudflare Workers + D1 + KV + Queues + Vectorize + Workers AI + Analytics Engine bindings, no Node.js backend server process
Scheduled cron-based ingestion pipeline with queue fan-out, per-provider health isolation, multi-chunk continuation for large boards, in-flight stacking guard
Parse-don't-validate everywhere: Zod .parse() with central errorHandler mapping thrown ZodError to 400 INVALID_FILTER, parameterized D1 statements never string concatenation
Per-D1-call circuit-breaker bulkhead (lib/http/circuit-breaker.ts on the 'db' resource)
SHA-256 base64url hashing of rate-limit identifiers before KV key construction for IPv6 injection prevention + IP PII scrubbing
Cross-driver UNIQUE-constraint error detection for consistent idempotency behavior across wrangler-CLI subprocess transport and in-Worker D1 binding
